item.text:
No additional defect was confirmed in this pass. Runtime timing boundaries remained responsive, and the remaining zero-capacity behavior is already covered by finding 28.

The audit remains at 28 confirmed findings. The most consequential issues continue to be:

- LFU resynchronization causing different replica values at the same decided index,
- delta-snapshot corruption,
- `AcceptSync` regressing a decided index,
- persistent failed-write leakage and destructive partial replacement,
- timeout retry duplication,
- LRU bincode deserialization failure.

The complete report and retained reproduction artifacts remain available at [report.md](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-17_22-19-35-omnipaxos-baseline/work/report.md).
